title: 💰 Public Sector Wage Overhauls — PSGICs 12.41% Hike, NABARD 20% & RBI Pensioner Increase
summary: Cabinet approved 12.41% overall wage hike (14% on basic/DA) for Public Sector General Insurance Companies (effective Aug 2022, ₹8,170.30 Cr outgo), NPS contribution increased to 14%, family pension 30%. Approved ~20% pay hike for NABARD (effective Nov 2022) and 10% pension enhancement on basic+DR for RBI retirees (₹2,696.82 Cr implication).
